notes.title: Major Update and Discount: The Story Deepens
notes.content:
[p]Ahoy, mateys! A mighty new update has washed ashore for [i]Pirates VR: Jolly Roger[/i] and it’s packed tighter than a sunken treasure chest! The game is now 40% OFF during the Steam Summer Sale![/p][p]
Here’s what’s new in this swashbucklin’ patch:
[/p][p][b]New Intro & Pirate’s Notes:[/b] The story now unfolds more clearly as you play, with a brand-new intro and scattered pirate notes that bring the legend to life.[/p][p][b]Now in Japanese![/b] A fresh localization for our crew sailing in from Japan.[/p][p][b]Parrot Options:[/b] Toggle the parrot’s jokes on or off. You can silence the squawks and wisecracks, but the helpful hints and guidance will still be there when ye need 'em.[/p][p][b]Parrot Fixes:[/b] That feathery menace got some polish (and maybe a cracker or two).[/p][p][b]Improved Swimming:[/b] Swim naturally by moving your arms down alternately, or stick to thumbsticks, your choice![/p][p][b]Smarter AI:[/b] Enemies are sharper than a cutlass. Keep yer wits about ye.[/p][p][b]Better Pickups & Inventory:[/b] Grabbing loot feels smoother and more reliable.[/p][p][b]Optimizations & Fixes:[/b] Less bugs, more booty.[/p][p][b]Haptics for Quest (via PC)[/b]: Playing on PC with a Quest headset? Enjoy newly added haptics for even deeper immersion.
[/p][p]This update makes the adventure more immersive than ever, whether you're solving the mystery of Davy Jones or just trying to silence that cheeky parrot.
[/p][p]Raise anchor, adventurer! [i]Pirates VR: Jolly Roger[/i] awaits![/p]

tags.feature: New Intro & Pirate’s Notes: The story now unfolds more clearly as you play, with a brand-new intro and scattered pirate notes that bring the legend to life.
Now in Japanese! A fresh localization for our crew sailing in from Japan.
Parrot Options: Toggle the parrot’s jokes on or off. You can silence the squawks and wisecracks, but the helpful hints and guidance will still be there when ye need 'em.

tags.bug: Parrot Fixes: That feathery menace got some polish (and maybe a cracker or two).

tags.feature: Improved Swimming: Swim naturally by moving your arms down alternately, or stick to thumbsticks, your choice!

tags.balance_change: Smarter AI: Enemies are sharper than a cutlass. Keep yer wits about ye.

tags.feature: Better Pickups & Inventory: Grabbing loot feels smoother and more reliable.

tags.bug: Optimizations & Fixes: Less bugs, more booty.

tags.feature: Haptics for Quest (via PC): Playing on PC with a Quest headset? Enjoy newly added haptics for even deeper immersion.

notes.title: Save System Update!
notes.content:
[b]Save System Update is Live! 🏴‍☠️ 💰[/b]

Ahoy, adventurers! 

We’ve been listening to your feedback, and we’re excited to bring you a major update to Pirates VR Jolly Roger! This update focuses on making your pirate journey smoother and more rewarding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/d6a00d821ed6f90b2fdda63bb38350274e8751d7.png[/img]

[b]What’s New?[/b]

[list]
[*] New Save System – Your hard-earned coins and treasures are now secured with a revamped save system, ensuring seamless progress.
[*] Optimization Improvements – A smoother adventure awaits! We’ve made enhancements to improve game performance and efficiency.
[*] Bug Fixes – We’ve addressed community-reported issues to enhance balance and enjoyment, including improved Valve Index support.
[/list]

If you’re enjoying Pirates VR Jolly Roger, please consider leaving a review on Steam! Your feedback helps us improve the game and lets new players know what to expect. ❤️

Thank you for your continued support! Keep the adventure going, and let us know what you think of the update. 🦜

tags.feature: New Save System – Your hard-earned coins and treasures are now secured with a revamped save system, ensuring seamless progress.

tags.bug: Bug Fixes – We’ve addressed community-reported issues to enhance balance and enjoyment, including improved Valve Index support.

notes.title: No, did you hear that?! 🦜
notes.content:
Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,
I hope you're feeling great today

Sometimes situations arise where you need to try again. But, sometimes you need to rethink your approach and try to find a solution in a different way. Perhaps this is the case?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/26ee32663d693e9bad376354725b797849ef695f.gif[/img]

Sometimes you may hear barbed phrases or even outright ridicule from this feathered...
He's always there, wherever you are. However, don't be angry with him :) 
In fact, he often shows you the way. He is your coordinator and your compass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/af061555e5080ffde8b1ac15c1ce7a5a99d6a5ef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/c6cfa1d687edfd379b495d52281718d73e144e1b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/e22d0bbc92070f9e2db9ed7a145807a47409feb1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/581e3ee1921ef5a6d8d851947e8a718dddc8479f.png[/img]

so our developers have made significant progress and some important tasks have been successfully completed:
+ most of the small bugs have been fixed
+ corrections and improvement of level design
+ optimization
+ some game mechanics
+ the final scene has been completed
+ subtitles + voice acting

As you can see, we are far advanced, but right now our development team is working on:
- active testing phase of the current version of the game, 
- improving game components, 
- compatibility with popular models of VR headsets, so that they work correctly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/528c0e234b4f349885b77b198c4a6a74ba417978.jpg[/img]

thanks for taking a few minutes today :) it's a pleasure for us. and thanks again for your reactions and attention!

See you all again. In a week :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1443620/Pirates_VR_Jolly_Roger/

Best Wishes,
Split Light Studio

notes.title: Do you hear that, too? 👀
notes.content:
[b]Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,[/b]
How are you doing? I hope your mood is the best :)

It seems it's time to show you something new to look forward to in Pirates VR: Jolly Roger

So, this time I want to move away from the “Island” location a bit and show you another location called “Cave”. A little variety wouldn't hurt, would it?
Mysterious and creepy, it's worth paying attention here. be attentive. including to the sounds (sometimes they can tell you a lot or give some clues).
Please don't look down for very long, otherwise you may recognize something (or someone) ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/aca06af7b978285ad6dd930be3a128b699b0b411.gif[/img]

Sometimes it's very helpful to look around you. For example, is there nothing threatening your life? Hmm. 
No, no...I'm not implying anything *wink*

Ok. a few snapshots for a leisurely examination:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/15bcc9b3dabcee4e8d11b3d8b95c0b39061b793a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/6a3b343a488f027cbfff9ce1fa7ed809509c6eb9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/89768be3f844c343b8c84dc4082846751de0a951.png[/img]

In the works:
- Game mechanics are being finalized/improved
- Subtitle system + voiceover 
- some level upgrades
- active testing

That's probably the most important thing I want to share today. 
I wish you a great week and look forward to sharing more with you ;)

I'll see you in a week!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1443620/Pirates_VR_Jolly_Roger

Best Wishes,
Split Light Studio

notes.title: Devlog #9 Sly as Flint's parrot! 🦜
notes.content:
[b]Yoo-hoo-hoo-hoo! Pirates,[/b]

It's been a week since we last met and it's good to be in touch with you again. 
There's a lot to discuss, so I'd like to go over it in order.

it's been a rough week, but it's been productive

So, uh. It's “The Island” time again and once again we have an uncomfortable route to tackle. What's the best way to do that? Not another word. Okey....

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/5d85bd6dbfadf29e1f17077de17f63e242b50e0b.gif[/img]

As you may recall, on “The Island” you are accompanied by a parrot. He's a very bad spy, a very bad spy. But, his job is to coordinate you, to guide you to the next point. This is your guide. Your flying map. However, you can try to capture him. Will it work?

Sly as Flint's parrot! 🦜 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/9f3fdb3e367fa03cc05962bbf68ae6b2440d6f49.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/efcbf1cc5aeb58e9dcb3c4212cb617bb804328ca.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/015fd1ad43b07379e7d8eb24f325bde1db7374ef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/e14e90c171187b7e235f6ce7e7a3586991de0bec.png[/img]

Shall we get to the news?

First of all, I would like to share some important news with you. Pirates VR: Jolly Roger now has a publisher, and it is VRKiwi.
We wish each other success and hope that this cooperation will be as fruitful as possible ;)

This is not the parrot from our game, however this bird is good too ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/0bd3c1a93a813b252906c1d0f53859c172f30a9e.png[/img]

Speaking about what the team is working on now, they have not only succeeded in their goals, but also significantly expanded the scope of work:

- Improvements and refinement of core gameplay mechanics.
- Integration and refinement of voice acting and subtitle system.
- Work on the final scene, as well as animations.
- Refinement and improvement of levels.
- Active testing of game builds and bug fixes based on the results.

Impressive. However, it's a work in progress

I'll see you in a week. See you soon ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1443620/Pirates_VR_Jolly_Roger/

Best Wishes,
Split Light Studio

tags.bug: - Active testing of game builds and bug fixes based on the results.

notes.title: Devlog #2 I'll catch you someday! 🦜
notes.content:
[b]Yoo-hoo-hoo![/b]
I have no doubt you guys did a great job this week. we did too :)
So today is the second Saturday, where we talk to you about the first location\level “The Island”

We don't want to leave you on your own, so we've developed some “informative pointers” to serve as clues for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/555f5dbe3d6fc42deb3652499de361355e236b1a.png[/img]

Their number will decrease as you become more experienced. And besides the “coins” that will help you figure out the controls and will eventually disappear, there is someone who as a true and loyal friend will not abandon you

[b]"I'll catch you someday!"[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/dea399ee713be161c88e9599e85da92d9588f9ca.gif[/img]

But, it actually has its own task, it's friendly to you. He's your guide. With his presence, he will guide you to your next task where you are needed. So, don't be offended by him and follow him :)

What stage is Pirates VR: Jolly Roger at right now?
- Still working on some of the final locations and levels - We can't wait to share our labors with you, but it's not time yet. First things first.
- Still working on fixing/adding minor improvements - Minor, but requiring attention and painstaking labor. Okay...

Just as we agreed last time - please take a look at these screenshots from the following locations (after “The Island”)
These are unofficial screenshots, so shhhh (this will be our little secret)

notes.title: Devlog #1 "Island"
notes.content:
[b]Yoo-hoo-hoo![/b]

After a bit of a lull, we open the curtain.
We are happy to be back in touch with you and after a long phase of active development we have something to share with you.

- However, everything in order.
By the way, in June we took part in Steam Fest, where we presented a demo of Pirates VR: Jolly Roger. Have you taken advantage of this opportunity yet? :)
The event also allowed us to get a little closer to our players, to be in an even better relationship with them. We received some wishes and shortcomings, which were successfully corrected. 

[u]Thank you for your valuable feedback, it's very valuable for us.[/u]

- Pirates VR: Jolly Roger will allow you to enjoy several locations, however the first one is "[i]THE ISLAND[/i]" so let's get to know more about it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/b175677dc6af7a96d4caac6632e2ca9f3acfcbdf.png[/img]

 This is the first, initial level that will introduce you to the universe of Pirates VR: Jolly Roger and act as a little tutorial for you. On your way you will encounter signposts and clues, so you won't feel left behind.  We'll be right by your side :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/555f5dbe3d6fc42deb3652499de361355e236b1a.png[/img]

Okay, and there goes my hat. There you are:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39088293/5381fd498089bc57fe951f6470c81b9698dc80b1.gif[/img]

What stage is Pirates VR: Jolly Roger at right now?
- Still working on some of the final locations and levels
- Still working on fixing/adding minor improvements
By the way, I'll show you some unofficial screenshots next week (just shhhh, it's a bit of a secret)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1443620/Pirates_VR_Jolly_Roger/

Best Wishes,
Split Light Studio
